# SYNTHETIC example dataset (software validation / onboarding only)

**All files here are synthetic.** They were generated by `tools/make_example_dataset.py` from knowledge-base
starting values, arbitrary areas and Gaussian noise. They are **not measurements**, are not derived from any real or
private data, and the chemistry is not meant to be realistic. Use them to learn and test the workflow.

| File | Use in the app |
|---|---|
| `SYNTHETIC_single_region_Nb3d.csv` | Tab 3, generic two-column import (structure `(Nb,Ti)2CTx`, core level Nb 3d) |
| `SYNTHETIC_provider_components_Nb3d.csv` | Tab 3, "Generic component CSV" provider table for the file above |
| `SYNdemo20x_*_SYNTHETIC_multi.csv` | Tab 3 ("PHI multi-region") and tab 6 (optional raw files) |
| `SYNTHETIC_provider_report.txt` | Tab 3 ("PHI MultiPak Curve Fit Summary") and tab 6 (provider report; includes synthetic atomic-concentration tables) |
| `SYNTHETIC_sample_metadata.csv` | Tab 6, sample metadata |
| `SYNTHETIC_truth.json` | Synthetic ground truth used to generate the spectra |

Samples: `1_Nb2AlC` (MAX profile), `2_Nb2CTx` (incl. an unsupported Cl 2p region), `3_(Nb0.6Ti0.4)2CTx`.
Regenerate with `python -I tools/make_example_dataset.py` (deterministic seeds).
